title: RaKai and Under Armour Take Their Partnership to the Next Level With the Launch of the UA Arc 96 “25XX”
summary: Launching RaKai’s first-ever footwear collaboration with UA, called the 25XX — RaKai’s exclusive interpretation of the UA Arc 96. UA's Full Access with RaKai social series has given fans a front row seat to the Twitch star’s journey as a UA brand ambassador — from taking over the main stage at Rolling Loud to stepping inside the boardroom, now creating his footwear collaboration.
body_markdown:
The 25XX is more than just a signature colorway. Earlier this year, RaKai and UA pulled back the veil of traditional product creation and invited his community to a live design session with the UA footwear team. More than 15,000 fans weighed in on everything from color direction to design details as the sneaker came to life in real time, transforming a process typically kept behind closed doors into a true collaborative experience.


The result is a sneaker shaped by RaKai’s personal story and by the people watching alongside him. His favorite UA colorway, Hyper Green, became a defining design element, nodding to the high-energy culture of online creators. The “25” in 25XX is an homage to RaKai’s former football jersey number and his community, which he calls 25XX, while a glow-in-the-dark outsole and fading midsole glow recreate late nights spent streaming at his desktop.
